name: BuddyPunch
summary: Time clock and employee time tracking for hourly teams. Track hours, breaks, PTO and overtime with GPS and photo punch-in, and export payroll-ready reports.
best_for: small-to-mid teams that need straightforward employee time tracking with GPS and payroll-ready exports
skip_if: you're a team of two or three — the fixed base fee makes the per-head cost sting until you scale up
honest_knock: That flat $19 base fee makes it pricey for very small teams — at three or four users the base fee dominates the bill, so it's better value once you're past a handful of employees. Two further limits come from Buddy Punch's own documentation. The free administrator seat cannot clock its own time, so a working owner pays for a second login. And outbound webhooks do not yet cover punches or time cards, so a payroll or HR system that needs live punch events has to poll the API instead.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month plus $19/mo base fee
pricing.notes: Per user plus a base fee, re-verified on buddypunch.com/pricing on 24 September 2026 (amounts unchanged since 5 September) and again on 22 October 2026: Starter $5.99 per user a month, Pro $7.99 and Advanced $13.99, each with a $19 base fee a month. Scheduling is $1 per user on Starter (included from Pro), real-time GPS $2 per user, onboarding and task checklists $4 per user, data retention for six years $24 per user a year (listed until September as $2 per user a month), advanced reporting $2 per user; the payroll add-on is $8 per user plus a $49 base fee a month. 14-day free trial, no card. On annual billing the per-user rates are $4.99, $6.99 and $12.99 and the base fee stays $19 a month. Administrators are free users; employees and managers count, and only active employees are billed. Advanced includes real-time GPS, advanced reporting and the onboarding/tasks add-on (listed as coming soon); the six-year data retention add-on can be bought on every plan, Advanced included.
